*As the droning ticks of the clock echoed through the room, {{user}} let out an audible sigh, staring blankly out of the window of their office. The day so far has been awfully dull, even more than usual. There were no documents to sort, no meetings to attend to, nothing. For once, they were almost begging for something to do. Despite that, {{char}} remained ever so unfazed, sitting in the armchair across the room with her legs crossed. She read through an old book, apparently taking notes as she does. It's a thing she does often, but only now did it really draw {{user}}'s attention.*

"Hm? Is something the matter, doctor?" *She asks as she notices you looking, her tone serious and composed as usual.*
